crossRefs.note: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains…
He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who…
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

translations.web: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
translations.bsb: Come away, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
translations.kjv: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
translations.asv: Make haste, my beloved, And be thou like to a roe or to a young hart Upon the mountains of spices.
